blocks.text:
Discovery call with Brightfold Home Goods on Aug 20, 2026. Brightfold ships about 420 pallets a month from the north warehouse, rising to around 600 in October and November, mostly carried by Tarrow Freight Lines with a broker for peak overflow. The main pain is missed morning pickups on the Site B lane (three in July) with no ETA visibility.

Both sides agreed in principle on a six-week pilot on the north warehouse to Site B lane, starting the week of Sep 14 and running to Oct 23, measured on on-time pickup and ETA visibility. Next step is a rate proposal based on three months of Brightfold shipment data, reviewed at a follow-up on Sep 1.

items.text: Send three months of shipment history as CSV (pallets per day, pickup times, weights if available).
Confirm Site B Saturday receiving hours in peak and brief the Site B manager on the new carrier.
Check with compliance whether the aerosol cleaning sprays are classed as hazmat or limited quantity.
Confirm the spend threshold that needs CFO sign-off.
Send lane-by-lane rate proposal: Site B pilot pricing plus indicative rates for the east DC and south cross-dock.
Check driver availability for a 3 to 5 pm late pickup window on the Site B lane.
Send pilot terms, on-time pickup measurement and insurance certificate for vendor setup.
Send calendar invite for the proposal review.

blocks.title: Follow-up email (draft)
blocks.subject: Next steps: Site B pilot and rate proposal
blocks.body:
Hi Owen, hi Lena,

Thanks for the time today. Here is what we agreed.

Pilot
- Lane: north warehouse to Site B only.
- Dates: week of Sep 14 to Oct 23, 2026 (six weeks), before the October volume increase.
- Measures: on-time pickup and ETA visibility, with two-hour pickup windows and alerts before a window is missed.

Next steps
- Lena: three months of shipment history as CSV by Aug 24. Also checking Site B Saturday hours and whether the aerosol sprays count as hazmat.
- Owen: confirm the threshold for CFO sign-off.
- Sam: lane-by-lane rate proposal by Aug 28, with pilot pricing for Site B and indicative rates for the east DC and south cross-dock. Sam is also checking an afternoon 3 to 5 pm pickup option.
- Tessa: pilot terms and our insurance certificate for your procurement team.

We will go through the proposal together on Tuesday, Sep 1 at 10. I will send the invite.

Best regards,
Tessa Harlow
Account Manager, Marrowbay Logistics

items.text: South cross-dock volume not given. Sam estimated about 50 pallets a month by subtraction; Lena said it varies from almost nothing to double.
Hazmat status of the aerosol cleaning sprays is unknown. It affects labeling and trailer choice for the pilot.
CFO approval threshold not known. Owen can approve the pilot but not a three-lane contract.
Late 3 to 5 pm pickup was requested but not committed. Driver availability still to be checked.
No due dates were set for the pilot terms, insurance certificate, CFO threshold or hazmat check.
Pilot start, end date and next meeting time were confirmed by both sides.
